entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Human warlord of the sanzoku bandits in the Sokenzan mountains of Kamigawa, wielder of the log-and-chain Tenza.

entities.name: Sanzoku
entities.description: Bandit gangs of the Sokenzan mountains united under Godo.

entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: Mountain range where Godo's bandits live.

entities.name: Tenza
entities.description: Godo's flail-like spiked log on a chain.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo whose forces tried to subjugate the Sokenzan.

entities.name: Pipe, the Skyfire Kirin
entities.description: Magical sword used by Godo's great-grandfather to take control of his bandit tribe.

entities.name: Yamazaki
entities.description: Brothers and lieutenants of Godo sent to Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Ogre who gave Godo a tile imprisoning the Yuki-onna.

entities.name: Yuki-onna
entities.description: Imprisoned snow spirit used against Konda's men who turned on Godo's men.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Pulled the Yuki-onna back to her original reign.

entities.name: Hall of the Bandit Lord
entities.description: Stone building in Godo's territory near Towabara.

events.summary: Godo's parents perish in Ganzan Pass; he unites the scattered sanzoku gangs.
events.quote: united the scattered Sanzoku gangs under his leadership

events.summary: Godo wages a guerilla war against Konda.
events.quote: waged a guerilla war against Konda for almost ten years

events.summary: Hidetsugu gives Godo a tile with the imprisoned Yuki-onna to use against Konda's men.
events.quote: gave him a tile with the imprisoned Yuki-onna

events.summary: The Yuki-onna turns on Godo's men and Godo faces her himself.
events.quote: the Yuki-onna's power was too great, and she started to prey upon his men

events.summary: Toshiro Umezawa pulls the Yuki-onna back to her original reign just before she kills Godo.
events.quote: the Yuki-onna was pulled back to her original reign

relations.quote: united the scattered Sanzoku gangs under his leadership
waged a guerilla war against Konda
advised him to use her against Konda's men
